title: satureja montana subsp. innota
intro: Satureja montana subsp. innota, commonly known as Innotto Savory, is a subspecies of the Satureja montana plant, which belongs to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is a type of savory herb native to the Mediterranean region, and its leaves are used for culinary and medicinal purposes. The health benefits of Innotto Savory include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils such as carvacrol and thymol, which are known for their therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
